step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard depicts a developer ('USER') accessing an internal portal via Route 53, which routes traffic through an ALB to an EKS cluster running on 100% EC2 Spot instances. When jobs execute, events are sent to SNS, fan out to SQS, and are consumed by replacement Spot pods to ensure resilient environment creation.
